method.connectivity: Actual same-net effective copper shapes and each saved filled-zone island are unioned per shared copper layer; via/PTH plating connects layers.
method.length: Dijkstra shortest path on actual track centrelines plus copper-covered pad-centre/junction links. 0.025 mm sampled join coverage; explicit track portions use Euclidean centreline lengths.
method.excluded: No length through pours, arc centrelines, or unrepresentable shape joins. Via/PTH vertical barrel length excluded; counted separately. No board or zone fill is saved.
method.limits: This graph length is not a continuous-copper geodesic, loop area, impedance, thermal result or pass/fail threshold. Existing explicit routes may have unmeasured pour shortcuts. Saved fill can be stale until final DRC/refill.

pairs.name: C68 ground to physically nearest MCU VSS
